metadata.summary: A large-scale, high-resolution chest x-ray dataset comprising >160,000 images from 67,000 patients, interpreted and reported by radiologists at Hospital Universitario de San Juan (Spain) from 2009 to 2017; includes six position views, demographic metadata, and multi-label annotations of radiographic findings, differential diagnoses, and anatomic locations mapped to UMLS.
metadata.custodian: Hospital Universitario de San Juan, Alicante, Spain
metadata.purpose: To support automated exploration of medical images alongside their associated radiology reports, enabling research in multimodal (image + text) AI for chest x-ray interpretation.

papers.title: PadChest — A large chest x-ray image dataset with multi-label annotated reports

ethics.privacy_measures: Data de-identified prior to release; no protected health information (PHI) included.

extraction.notes: Baseline card derived solely from dataset_catalog.xlsx real metadata; remaining fields require paper/README or manual completion.
pending_verification: geography.countries is heuristically inferred from limitation text; requires manual verification

known_limitations: Single-center, Spain-only origin limits geographic and healthcare-system generalizability.
Reports are exclusively in Spanish — may limit linguistic and cultural applicability.
No explicit reporting of age, sex, or ethnicity distributions hinders bias analysis.
73% of labels are algorithmically generated, introducing potential systematic annotation bias.
bias_and_limitations.modifications: Yes — 73% of labels derived via supervised RNN with attention; hierarchical taxonomy constructed and UMLS-mapped.
bias_sources: label generation (algorithmic majority, validation limited to Micro-F1)
bias_and_limitations.representativeness_concerns: Single-center Spanish cohort; no demographic breakdown provided.
bias_and_limitations.generalizability_statement: Limited generalizability outside Spanish-speaking, single-hospital clinical settings; unknown impact of temporal shifts in imaging practice (2009–2017).
bias_and_limitations.subgroup_coverage: No subgroup coverage data reported (e.g., age, sex, ethnicity, socioeconomic status).
bias_and_limitations.missing_data: Demographic attributes (age, sex, ethnicity) not reported; exact counts of missing fields unspecified.

data_origin.selection_rationale: Images and reports were obtained from routine clinical chest x-ray examinations performed at Hospital Universitario de San Juan between 2009 and 2017.
data_origin.data_shifts_overtime: Data collected from 2009 to 2017; no explicit description of temporal shifts in equipment, protocols, or reporting practices.

population.target_population: Patients undergoing clinical chest x-ray examinations at a Spanish university hospital.
population.inclusion_criteria: Chest x-ray examinations performed at Hospital Universitario de San Juan, 2009–2017.

annotation.annotation_method: 27% manually annotated by trained physicians; remaining labels generated via supervised recurrent neural network with attention, validated on independent test set (Micro-F1 = 0.93).
annotation.labeling_provenance: Radiology reports in Spanish, labeled with hierarchical taxonomy mapped to UMLS.
annotation.label_noise_description: Labels for 73% of reports were algorithmically generated (RNN+attention); though validated (Micro-F1=0.93), residual noise is expected.
